import cv2, numpy as np

# In obs_0001 (pos=(0,0), heading=0):
# Plant 2 is on the right:
img1 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0001.png')
# Find pot of plant 2 in obs 1:
pot_mask = (img1[:,:,2] > 140) & (img1[:,:,0] < 80) & (img1[:,:,1] < 100) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 256)
ys, xs = np.where(pot_mask)
print('Plant 2 in obs 1: xs:', xs.min(), xs.max(), 'ys:', ys.min(), ys.max())
contact_y = ys.max()
center_x = (xs.min() + xs.max()) / 2.0
d1 = 256.0 * 1.55 / (contact_y - 255.5)
dx1 = (center_x - 255.5) * d1 / 256.0
print(f'Plant 2 in obs 1: d={d1:.3f}, dx={dx1:.3f} -> x={dx1:.3f}, y={d1:.3f}')

# Sofa in obs 1:
# Grey sofa behind plant 2 on the right:
sofa_mask = (img1[:,:,0] > 100) & (img1[:,:,0] < 140) & (img1[:,:,1] > 100) & (img1[:,:,1] < 140) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 350)
ys_s, xs_s = np.where(sofa_mask & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 300))
print('Sofa in obs 1: xs:', xs_s.min(), xs_s.max(), 'ys:', ys_s.min(), ys_s.max())
contact_y_s = ys_s.max()
center_x_s = (xs_s.min() + xs_s.max()) / 2.0
d_s = 256.0 * 1.55 / (contact_y_s - 255.5)
dx_s = (center_x_s - 255.5) * d_s / 256.0
print(f'Sofa in obs 1: d={d_s:.3f}, dx={dx_s:.3f} -> x={dx_s:.3f}, y={d_s:.3f}')
"
